meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可启动本地 Dashboard 查看拆文库、写作项目和编辑文本。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、$story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集中管理小说拆文库、写作项目与编辑，一键打开写作工作台
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在写网络小说，需要整理拆文库和写作项目
copy.tagline_en: Manage novel breakdowns, writing projects, and editing from one dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're writing web novels and need to manage breakdowns and projects

howto.what: 这个技能是网络小说工具箱的入口。Claude 会先分析你的请求，把任务分给对应的子技能（拆文、写作、扫榜、去AI味、封面、导入等），也能检查更新、切换当前书目。若意图模糊，它会反问你。
howto.when: 输入 /story、$story、/网文，或说「我想写小说」「检查更新」等关键词时触发；当你的请求意图不明确时，也会由它接管并分发。

say.text: 我想写一部长篇小说，先做设定。
say.note: 会引导你进入长篇写作或初始化环境。

say.text: 检查更新，看有没有新版本。
say.note: 会对比版本并询问是否更新。

say.text: 帮我拆解这本书，分析黄金三章。

howto.what_en: This skill is the entry point of the web-novel toolbox. Claude analyzes your request and routes it to a specific sub-skill (story analysis, writing, ranking scan, de-AI-ing, cover, import, etc.), checks for updates, and switches active books. If intent is unclear, it asks you.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /story, $story, /网文, or phrases like "I want to write a novel" / "check for updates". It also takes over when your request intent is ambiguous and dispatches accordingly.

say_en.text: I want to write a long novel, start with settings.
say_en.note: Routes to long-form writing or setup.

say_en.text: Check for updates, any new version?
say_en.note: Compares versions and asks whether to update.

say_en.text: Help me break down this book, analyze the golden three chapters.
